entities.name: PMID:25073836
observations: Single-center, open-label, randomized two-way crossover study compared single-dose 1% testosterone solution applied to axilla versus inner arm in healthy premenopausal women aged 18–45 years.
Serum total/free testosterone PK endpoints included AUC0–72, Cmax, and Tmax; accessible abstract gives no numerical Cmax or AUC values.

entities.name: Axillary testosterone absorption
observations: In the crossover comparison of topical 1% testosterone solution in healthy premenopausal women, axillary application produced faster and greater serum testosterone increases than inner-arm application.
Baseline-corrected AUC-based bioavailability was approximately twofold higher after axillary application; exact AUC and Cmax values were not available in the accessible abstract.
